text_blocks.snippet: Managed Detection and Response (MDR) for Managed Service Providers (MSPs) is an outsourced cybersecurity service that delivers 24/7 threat monitoring, human-led incident response, and advanced detection without requiring the MSP to build and staff an internal Security Operations Center (SOC).
snippet_highlighted_words: an outsourced cybersecurity service that delivers 24/7 threat monitoring, human-led incident response, and advanced detection without requiring the MSP to build and staff an internal Security Operations Center (SOC)

text_blocks.snippet: Why MSPs Partner with MDR Providers

list.snippet: Overcoming the Skills Gap: Building a 24/7 in-house SOC is cost-prohibitive and operationally complex due to ongoing training and analyst shortages.
24/7 Coverage: MDR partners monitor endpoints, cloud workloads, and identity tools around the clock, intercepting threats outside of normal business hours.
Reducing Alert Fatigue: Advanced analytics, AI triage, and human-led investigations filter out false positives so technicians only handle validated threats.
Scaling Revenue: Partnering with an MDR allows MSPs to expand their security portfolios, increase recurring revenue per client, and improve client retention.

MSP-Friendly Models: According to discussions on Reddit, there is a community consensus that true "MSP-friendly" MDR services must accommodate flexible billing models (such as per-endpoint or usage-based pricing) rather than rigid enterprise minimums.

White-Label & Multi-Tenant Support: Many top providers offer white-label reporting, centralized multi-tenant dashboards, and pre-approved automated response actions that integrate directly with RMM and PSA tools.
Popular Offerings: Vendors tailored to this channel include Bitdefender MDR for MSPs, Guardz, and channel-focused solutions like Arctic Wolf and ESET.
